cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json,subprocess,sys
d=json.load(open('examples.json'))
for c in d:
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=c['stdin'].encode(),capture_output=True)
    print('====',c['name'], p.returncode)
    try:
        got=json.loads(p.stdout)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR',e,p.stdout[:500],p.stderr[:2000]); continue
    exp=c['expected']
    if got!=exp:
        print('GOT:',json.dumps(got,indent=1)[:3000])
        print('EXP:',json.dumps(exp,indent=1)[:3000])
"
